observationsForTheReviewer: The exception removes the approve_url wherever it appears in the output rather than only from the waiting line, so a regression that printed that same URL on another line would pass the invariant. Narrowing it further would mean the test parsing lines, which is more machinery than the risk earns; the measured control above shows every other way of naming the host still fails.

The implementer's proof entry says the whole-package run leaves 18 failures in cmd/agent-secrets; I measured 13, here and on main, with identical names. The claim that matters — that every remaining failure is the pod's and not the branch's — holds either way.

Still true from earlier rounds, and still not a failure: a signed-in person of the domain who is not the approver is served the whole record page, with no decision form. The spec's design describes that page and A2 requires only that she decide nothing, which she does not.
